summary: Verified Lembretes page, Agenda move/cancel actions with WhatsApp notify, quick booking cancel flow, manager pro-filter, and responsive fixes (390/820). Backend reschedule (409 without force, 200 with force) and /appointments/reminders (manager/pro scoping, client 403) all pass. 4 backend tests passed, 1 skipped (no other-pro appt); 100% frontend flows worked as specified.

issues: When a specific date is picked (not hoje/amanhã), page title reads 'Horários de no dia 15/05' — awkward Portuguese due to backend returning label 'no dia 15/05' concatenated with 'Horários de '. Consider changing UI concat to 'Horários {label}' (=> 'Horários no dia 15/05') or backend label to 'do dia 15/05'.

AgendaItemActions.jsx: after successful move, day state uses input value (naive local date). Works for happy path but if user moves to a date in a different local TZ from server (BR_TZ), agenda-day filter may drift by one day. Not observed in this test since date input is local YYYY-MM-DD.
server.py reschedule_appointment: sets forced=True whenever appt.forced OR data.force; forced flag is 'sticky' — once forced, subsequent non-force reschedules still keep forced=True. Cosmetic only.
